title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 25
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 25: Amaziah's victory over Edom, his turn to Edom's gods, and his defeat by Joash.

questions.text: How did Amaziah do what was right in Yahweh's eyes?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 25:2 says Amaziah did what was right in Yahweh's eyes, but not with a perfect heart.

answers.text: With all his heart, like David

questions.text: Why did Amaziah not put to death the children of the servants who had killed his father?
questions.explanation: Amaziah killed the servants who had killed his father, but he did not put their children to death; he did according to what is written in the law in the book of Moses: "every man shall die for his own sin."

answers.text: He followed the law in the book of Moses
The prophet asked him to spare them
The children were too young to fight

questions.text: For what price did Amaziah hire one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel?
questions.explanation: He hired one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.

questions.text: How did the man of God answer Amaziah's worry about the hundred talents?
questions.explanation: The man of God answered, "Yahweh is able to give you much more than this."

answers.text: "Yahweh is able to give you much more than this."
"The army of Israel will pay it back."
"Take it from the treasures of the temple."
"You must go to war with them anyway."

questions.text: Where did Amaziah strike ten thousand of the children of Seir?
questions.explanation: Amaziah took courage, led his people out, went to the Valley of Salt, and struck ten thousand of the children of Seir.

answers.text: The valley of the son of Hinnom

questions.text: What did Amaziah bring back after the slaughter of the Edomites?
questions.explanation: He brought the gods of the children of Seir, set them up to be his gods, bowed down before them and burned incense to them.

answers.text: The crown of the king of Edom
The gods of the children of Seir

questions.text: What did Amaziah say to the prophet who rebuked him?
questions.explanation: The king said to him, "Have we made you one of the king's counselors? Stop! Why should you be struck down?"

answers.text: "Have we made you one of the king's counselors?"
"I will tear down the altars of Edom."
"Go and anoint my son as king."

questions.text: In Joash's message, what trampled down the thistle?
questions.explanation: Joash said a wild animal that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle.

answers.text: The cedar that was in Lebanon
A wild animal that was in Lebanon

questions.text: Where did Joash king of Israel and Amaziah king of Judah meet in battle?
questions.explanation: Joash and Amaziah looked one another in the face at Beth Shemesh, which belongs to Judah.

questions.text: Where did Amaziah flee when a conspiracy was made against him?
questions.explanation: They made a conspiracy against him in Jerusalem; he fled to Lachish, but they sent after him and killed him there.
